title: 歩道のプランターボックス
description: 歩道や店先に置く、耐候性鋼の長方形プランターと植え込みです。箱形の外壁と上縁のつば、マルチング材の表面、刈り込んだ低木の葉の塊と幹、底の水抜き用スペーサー脚を造形しています。植物は簡略化した塊で、葉の一枚一枚、風の揺れ、土の内部、給水設備は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.541 × 0.829 × 0.640 m、4,224三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A rectangular weathering-steel planter with clipped shrubs for sidewalks and shopfronts. It models the box wall and top rim flange, a mulch surface, simplified foliage masses with woody stems, and drainage spacer feet. Plants are simplified masses without individual leaves or wind motion; soil volume and irrigation are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.541 × 0.829 × 0.640 m; 4,224 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
